aiOverview.content:
Ryanair's general terms and conditions govern bookings, baggage rules, liabilities, and passenger responsibilities across operating entities including Ryanair DAC, Ryanair UK, and Malta Air.
- Free Small Cabin Bag: All fares include one small personal bag measuring max 40 x 30 x 20 cm, which must fit under the seat in front of you.
- Priority / Large Cabin Bag: Purchasing Priority or a Plus/Flexi ticket lets you bring an additional 10kg large cabin bag (max 55 x 40 x 20 cm). Oversized gate bags incur a fee of €/£70.00 to €/£75.00.
- Checked Baggage: You can purchase up to three checked-in bags per passenger (typically 10kg or 20kg options, plus select 23kg options).
- Batteries & Electronics: Spare lithium batteries and power banks (under 100Wh) are allowed in carry-on baggage only—they cannot go in overhead lockers or checked luggage.
Passenger Responsibilities & Documents
- Travel Documents: You are solely responsible for holding valid passports, national ID cards, visas, or ETAs required for your destination. Ryanair can refuse carriage or charge entry-refusal fines/costs if documents are missing or non-compliant.
- Check-In & Communication: Flight notices are sent via your booking email or SMS. If you do not have a valid email on file, you must check flight schedules 24 to 72 hours prior to departure.
- Fraud & Payments: Bookings with suspected fraud, unverified cards, or chargebacks may be cancelled without notice.
Compensation & Claims
- EU 261 / Delays & Cancellations: Compensation claims under EU Regulation 261/2004 must be submitted directly to Ryanair before engaging third-party agencies.
- Baggage Damage / Loss: Written notice for damaged or lost checked baggage must be filed within 7 days (or 21 days for delayed baggage).
- Dispute Resolution: Unresolved complaints can be escalated to Aviation ADR within 12 months.
You can review the full legal documentation directly on the Ryanair General Terms and Conditions page or search specific fee schedules via the Ryanair Table of Fees.

- Hold Luggage: Checked baggage is not included as standard on basic flight-only bookings and must be purchased separately.
Cancellations and Refunds
- 24-Hour Grace Period: If you cancel your booking in full within 24 hours of making it, easyJet provides a full refund minus a cancellation fee.
- After 24 Hours: Flight-only bookings are generally non-refundable if you cancel yourself.
- Airline-Initiated Cancellations: If easyJet cancels your flight, you are entitled to a choice of a full cash refund, a voucher, or a free transfer to an alternative flight. You may also be eligible for care (meals, hotel accommodation) or statutory compensation under applicable passenger rights regulations.
Medical and Special Travel Limits
- Pregnancy: Single pregnancies are permitted to travel up to 35 weeks, and multiple pregnancies (e.g., twins) up to 32 weeks (complications require GP clearance).
- Medical Conditions & Post-Surgery: Specific wait times apply after major medical events or surgeries (e.g., 14 days after heart surgery, 10 days after abdominal surgery, 6 weeks after chest surgery).
- Medication: Essential medications, insulin, and inhalers must be kept in your hand baggage.

aiOverview.content:
You can view the full legal rules and updates on the Virgin Atlantic Conditions of Carriage.
Key policies from the official terms include:
Check-In and Boarding
- Check-In Deadline: You must finish check-in and bag drop at least 70 minutes before your scheduled departure time.
- Boarding Gate: You must be at the boarding gate at least 30 minutes before departure.
- Missed Flights: If you miss your flight, go to the airport and present yourself to airport staff; they can move you to the next available Virgin Atlantic flight at no extra charge (unless you pick an alternate destination or a higher cabin class). If you fail to show up without notifying them, your return or onward flights may be cancelled.
Baggage Rules
- Hand Baggage Allowance: All passengers can bring a small under-seat bag (such as a laptop bag or handbag) plus main hand baggage allowances depending on your ticket class.
- Prohibited in Checked Baggage: You cannot pack essential medication, medical equipment, or house/car keys in your checked hold baggage.
- Liability Limits: Baggage damage or loss is limited under international agreements like the Montreal Convention up to 1,519 Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) per passenger, unless a special declaration is made at check-in.
Refunds & Changes
- Refund Eligibility: If your ticket is refundable and completely unused, you can request a refund of the fare, surcharges, and applicable taxes.
- Third-Party Bookings: If someone else paid for or booked your ticket, they have authority to manage or change the reservation unless you notify Virgin Atlantic otherwise.

aiOverview.content:
You can read or download the official Spirit Airlines Contract of Carriage PDF directly from Spirit Airlines' legal resource library.
- Reservations & Validity: Confirmed reservations apply strictly to the designated dates, times, and flights. Domestic gates close 15 minutes before departure and international gates close 30 minutes before departure.
- Dress Code & Conduct Rules: Spirit enforces passenger conduct guidelines that prohibit barefoot travel, see-through garments, exposed private parts, and lewd, obscene, or offensive clothing or body art.
- Baggage & Fees: Personal items meeting size requirements are free, while carry-on bags and checked luggage incur separate fees.
Would you like help finding specific sections of the contract—such as refund policies, baggage liability, or pet rules?
